🚨 HMPV Outbreak in China: Key Points

• No pandemic threat - confirmed by medical experts

• What is it? Human Metapneumovirus, discovered in 2001
    - Causes common cold-like symptoms
    - Typically resolves in 1 week

• Current situation:
    - Part of normal winter respiratory season
    - Chinese authorities report no emergency
    - WHO not concerned

• High-risk groups:
    - Young children
    - Elderly
    - Immunocompromised individuals

nodes.author: Rinaz135
nodes.text:
• Prevention is key:
    - Regular hand washing
    - Stay home when sick

🔑 Bottom line: This is a routine seasonal outbreak, not a new virus or pandemic risk.
